Voroshylivka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Voroshylivka's Jewish community, settled in the late 17th century, built a wooden synagogue that period and a stone synagogue in the mid-19th century, reaching roughly half the town's population (1,592 of 3,180) by 1897. Germans murdered those who had not fled almost immediately after capturing the town in mid-1941; under subsequent Transnistria administration, hundreds of Jews from Mohyliv-Podilskyi and its surroundings — documented elsewhere in this collection — were brought to the resulting ghetto, about half of whom died, while further deportees arrived from Bessarabia and Bukovina, leaving only 278 people by September 1943.
